# 12-Week Strength Programme — Endometriosis-Aware Periodisation
**Client:** 34F, intermediate, Stage III endometriosis (post-surgical)
**Programme start:** Monday 2026-06-01
**Programme end:** Sunday 2026-08-23

---

## Cycle Map (predicted, based on LMP 2026-05-04, 27-day cycle, 4 flow days)

| Cycle | Menses (flow) | Follicular | Ovulation | Luteal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | May 31 – Jun 3 | Jun 4 – Jun 14 | ~Jun 15 | Jun 16 – Jun 26 |
| C2 | Jun 27 – Jun 30 | Jul 1 – Jul 11 | ~Jul 12 | Jul 13 – Jul 23 |
| C3 | Jul 24 – Jul 27 | Jul 28 – Aug 7 | ~Aug 8 | Aug 9 – Aug 19 |
| C4 | Aug 20 – Aug 23 (start) | — | — | — |

## Flagged Modification Windows (no HIIT, no heavy Valsalva, no jumping)

- **Flow days:** May 31 – Jun 3 / Jun 27 – Jun 30 / Jul 24 – Jul 27 / Aug 20 – Aug 23
- **Flare 1 (post-lap follow-up):** Jul 10 – Jul 13
- **Flare 2 (stress-correlated):** Aug 4 – Aug 7

On these days we run a **Restorative Session template** (described once below and referenced by date).

---

## Programming Philosophy

We're running a **3-phase linear-to-undulating model** synced to her cycle:
- **Follicular weeks** → highest intensity, top sets, PRs welcome (estrogen-driven recovery and pain tolerance favour heavy work).
- **Luteal weeks** → moderate intensity, more volume/accessory, RPE capped.
- **Flow weeks** → deload-feel; technical work, tempo, unilateral, no Valsalva.
- **Flare days** → swap for Restorative template regardless of phase.

Frequency: **4 sessions/week** — Mon (Lower Push-dominant), Tue (Upper), Thu (Lower Pull-dominant), Fri (Upper). Wed/Sat low-intensity Zone-2 walk or mobility 30–40 min. Sunday full rest.

---

## Restorative Session Template (used on flow + flare days)

45 minutes total. No breath-holds, no plyos, RPE cap 6.
1. Diaphragmatic breathing + cat-cow, 5 min
2. Goblet squat to box, 3×8 @ RPE 5
3. DB Romanian deadlift, 3×10 light, controlled tempo (3-1-1)
4. Half-kneeling landmine press, 3×8/side
5. Single-arm DB row, 3×10/side
6. Side-lying clam + dead bug, 2 rounds × 10 reps
7. Pelvic floor down-training: 90/90 supported breathing, 5 min

Use this on every dated flow/flare day below; the dated session is replaced, not added.

---

# PHASE 1 — Anatomical Adaptation & Reassessment (Weeks 1–4)
**Goals:** establish baselines, groove mechanics post-lap, build work capacity. RPE cap 7.

## Week 1 (Jun 1 – Jun 7) — **Flow Mon–Wed, Follicular Thu–Sun**
- **Mon Jun 1 (flow):** Restorative template.
- **Tue Jun 2 (flow):** Restorative template.
- **Wed Jun 3 (flow):** Easy walk 30 min, mobility.
- **Thu Jun 4 — Lower Pull:** Trap-bar deadlift 4×6 @ RPE 6–7; DB walking lunge 3×8/leg; 45° back extension 3×10; Pallof press 3×12/side.
- **Fri Jun 5 — Upper:** Incline DB press 4×8; Chest-supported row 4×8; Half-kneeling landmine press 3×10/side; Face pulls 3×15.
- **Sat:** Zone-2 walk 40 min.

## Week 2 (Jun 8 – Jun 14) — **Full Follicular**
- **Mon — Lower Push:** Back squat 4×6 @ RPE 7; Bulgarian split squat 3×8/leg; Leg press 3×10; Plank 3×30 s.
- **Tue — Upper:** Bench press 4×6 @ RPE 7; Pull-up (assisted as needed) 4×6; Seated DB shoulder press 3×8; Cable row 3×10.
- **Thu — Lower Pull:** Conventional deadlift 4×5 @ RPE 7; Hip thrust 3×8; RDL 3×8; Hanging knee raise 3×10.
- **Fri — Upper:** OHP 4×6 @ RPE 7; Lat pulldown 4×8; Incline DB press 3×10; Barbell curl + triceps pushdown superset 3×10.

## Week 3 (Jun 15 – Jun 21) — **Ovulation Mon, Luteal rest of week**
- **Mon — Lower Push:** Back squat 5×5 @ RPE 7 (heaviest day this phase); Front-foot-elevated split squat 3×8/leg; Leg curl 3×12.
- **Tue — Upper:** Bench 4×6 @ RPE 7; Weighted chin-up 4×6; DB lateral raise 3×12; Cable row 3×10.
- **Thu — Lower Pull:** Trap-bar DL 4×6 @ RPE 7; Hip thrust 4×8; Reverse hyper or back ext 3×12; Dead bug 3×8/side.
- **Fri — Upper:** OHP 4×6; Pulldown 4×10; DB bench 3×10; Face pulls + curls 3×12.

## Week 4 (Jun 22 – Jun 28) — **Late luteal, flow Jun 27–28**
Deload-light week. RPE cap 6.
- **Mon — Lower Push:** Goblet squat 4×8; Reverse lunge 3×8/leg; Leg press 3×10 light.
- **Tue — Upper:** Incline DB press 4×8; Chest-supported row 4×8; Landmine press 3×8/side.
- **Thu — Lower Pull:** Hip thrust 4×8 moderate; RDL 3×8; Pallof 3×12.
- **Fri Jun 26 — Upper:** Bench 3×5 @ RPE 6; Pulldown 3×8; DB OHP 3×10.
- **Sat Jun 27 (flow):** Restorative.
- **Sun Jun 28 (flow):** Rest or restorative.

---

# PHASE 2 — Strength Accumulation (Weeks 5–8)
**Goals:** progress top sets, increase intensity in follicular weeks, accumulate volume in luteal. RPE cap 8 on top sets in follicular weeks only.

## Week 5 (Jun 29 – Jul 5) — **Flow Mon–Tue, Follicular Wed–Sun**
- **Mon Jun 29 (flow):** Restorative.
- **Tue Jun 30 (flow):** Restorative.
- **Thu Jul 2 — Lower Pull:** Conventional DL 5×3 @ RPE 7–8; Hip thrust 4×6; RDL 3×8; Hanging leg raise 3×8.
- **Fri Jul 3 — Upper:** Bench 5×3 @ RPE 7–8; Weighted pull-up 4×5; OHP 3×6; Cable row 3×10.
- **Sat:** Walk 40 min.

## Week 6 (Jul 6 – Jul 12) — **Follicular, but FLARE WINDOW Jul 10–13**
- **Mon Jul 6 — Lower Push:** Back squat 5×3 @ RPE 8 (heavy day; capitalise on follicular phase); Bulgarian split squat 3×6/leg; Leg press 3×8.
- **Tue Jul 7 — Upper:** OHP 5×3 @ RPE 8; Weighted chin-up 4×5; Incline DB press 3×8; Face pull 3×15.
- **Thu Jul 9 — Lower Pull:** Trap-bar DL 5×3 @ RPE 8; Hip thrust 4×6; Back extension 3×10.
- **Fri Jul 10 (FLARE):** Restorative.
- **Sat Jul 11 (FLARE):** Rest or gentle walk only.
- **Sun Jul 12 (FLARE):** Rest.

## Week 7 (Jul 13 – Jul 19) — **Flare Mon, Luteal Tue–Sun**
- **Mon Jul 13 (FLARE final day):** Restorative.
- **Tue Jul 14 — Upper:** Bench 4×5 @ RPE 7; Chest-supported row 4×8; DB OHP 3×8; Curls + triceps 3×10. (Easing back in — note: no top single, no max effort.)
- **Thu Jul 16 — Lower Pull:** RDL 4×6 @ RPE 7; Hip thrust 4×8; Reverse hyper 3×10; Pallof 3×12.
- **Fri Jul 17 — Upper:** OHP 4×5 @ RPE 7; Pulldown 4×8; Incline DB 3×10.
- **Sat:** Add a 4th session if recovered — **Lower Push:** Front squat 4×5 @ RPE 7 (replaces the missed Mon lower-push); otherwise skip.

## Week 8 (Jul 20 – Jul 26) — **Luteal Mon–Thu, Flow Fri–Sun**
Volume accumulation, RPE cap 7.
- **Mon — Lower Push:** Back squat 4×5 @ RPE 7; Walking lunge 3×8/leg; Leg curl 3×12; Plank 3×45 s.
- **Tue — Upper:** Bench 4×5 @ RPE 7; Pull-up 4×6; DB lateral raise 3×12.
- **Thu Jul 23 — Lower Pull:** Trap-bar DL 4×5 @ RPE 7; Hip thrust 4×8; RDL 3×8.
- **Fri Jul 24 (flow):** Restorative.
- **Sat Jul 25 (flow):** Rest.
- **Sun Jul 26 (flow):** Rest or restorative.

---

# PHASE 3 — Intensification & Realisation (Weeks 9–12)
**Goals:** express strength gains, top sets in follicular, taper into final week. RPE cap 8.5 follicular, 7 luteal.

## Week 9 (Jul 27 – Aug 2) — **Flow Mon, Follicular Tue–Sun**
- **Mon Jul 27 (flow):** Restorative.
- **Tue Jul 28 — Upper:** Bench — work to a top set of 3 @ RPE 8, then 3×5 backoff @ ~85% of top; Weighted pull-up 4×4; DB OHP 3×8.
- **Thu Jul 30 — Lower Pull:** Conventional DL — top set of 2 @ RPE 8, then 3×4 backoff; Hip thrust 4×6; Back ext 3×10.
- **Fri Jul 31 — Upper:** OHP top set of 3 @ RPE 8, 3×5 backoff; Chest-supported row 4×6; Face pull 3×15.
- **Sat Aug 1 — Lower Push:** Back squat top set of 3 @ RPE 8, 3×5 backoff; Bulgarian split squat 3×6/leg.

## Week 10 (Aug 3 – Aug 9) — **Follicular but FLARE WINDOW Aug 4–7**
- **Mon Aug 3 — Lower Push:** Back squat — top single @ RPE 8.5 (anchor lift before flare); 4×3 backoff @ 85%; Leg press 3×8. (Front-load the heaviest work to Monday given the flare window starts Tue.)
- **Tue Aug 4 (FLARE):** Restorative.
- **Wed Aug 5 (FLARE):** Rest.
- **Thu Aug 6 (FLARE):** Restorative.
- **Fri Aug 7 (FLARE):** Rest or gentle walk.
- **Sat Aug 8 — Upper:** Bench 4×5 @ RPE 7 (re-entry, no top single); Cable row 4×8; DB OHP 3×8.
- **Sun:** Rest.

## Week 11 (Aug 10 – Aug 16) — **Luteal, full training week**
Last hard week. RPE cap 7.5.
- **Mon — Lower Push:** Back squat 4×4 @ RPE 7.5; Walking lunge 3×8/leg; Leg curl 3×10.
- **Tue — Upper:** Bench 4×4 @ RPE 7.5; Weighted chin-up 4×4; DB lateral raise 3×12.
- **Thu — Lower Pull:** Trap-bar DL 4×4 @ RPE 7.5; Hip thrust 4×6; RDL 3×8.
- **Fri — Upper:** OHP 4×4 @ RPE 7.5; Pulldown 4×8; Incline DB press 3×10.

## Week 12 (Aug 17 – Aug 23) — **Late luteal → flow Aug 20–23. Test/Taper week.**
- **Mon Aug 17 — Lower Push:** Back squat — work up to a heavy 3 @ RPE 8 (retest); no backoff.
- **Tue Aug 18 — Upper:** Bench — heavy 3 @ RPE 8 (retest); Pull-up max reps; done.
- **Wed Aug 19:** Light walk.
- **Thu Aug 20 (flow):** Restorative.
- **Fri Aug 21 (flow):** Rest.
- **Sat Aug 22 (flow):** Restorative.
- **Sun Aug 23 (flow):** Rest. **Programme review.**

---

## Cross-Cutting Notes

**Valsalva substitution.** On flow/flare days the restorative template uses tempo and breath-with-exhale-on-effort. Even outside those days, given Stage III endometriosis and recent laparoscopy, I'd cue *light* bracing (60–70% effort) on all loaded lifts under RPE 7, and only allow full Valsalva for top sets in follicular weeks. No max breath-holds during luteal phase regardless.

**Jumping.** Programme contains no plyos by design — there's no plyo-block in this phase model. If she requests later, introduce only in follicular weeks outside flagged windows.

**Recovery.**
- Sleep target: 8 h; flag any week she drops below 7.
- Daily 10-min diaphragmatic breathing + pelvic floor down-training, especially in luteal and during flare windows.
- Heat application (pad) for pelvic pain — fine pre-session.
- Magnesium glycinate 200–300 mg evenings if she tolerates (refer to her physician).

**Autoregulation rules.**
- Pain >4/10 on her endo scale → drop to Restorative template that day, regardless of programme.
- New unexpected flare (outside the two flagged windows) → repeat that week's pattern the following week, shifting subsequent weeks by one. Don't try to "catch up" missed sessions.
- If a follicular top-set day lands on a day she reports poor sleep (<6 h), cap RPE at 7 and skip the top single.

**Tracking.** Daily 1–10 pain log, daily RPE log, weekly bodyweight, and a check-in note every Sunday so we can re-plot the cycle map if her period shifts. If the next period arrives more than ±2 days off the prediction, I'll resend an updated phase map for the remaining weeks.
